仪器: B10 高精度 Type-C 多功能无线充测试 USB 电压电流表 PD3.2 充电检测仪，标称精度 <0.2%
测点: 仪表串联在 Type-C 供电与开发板之间（整板输入，非纯 NPU 功率）
采样率: 仪表不提供机器采样接口；按人工定时拍照形成离散读数，V/A/W 小数点后 5 位（共 6 位），mAh/mWh 7 位整数
空闲基线: dense idle / lossless idle：相同 bit/XSA/ELF、模型已装载、JTAG/PS 状态一致、replay 未启动或停在冻结 idle
负载同步: dense/lossless continuous full 复用 CP5b 397 样本 PL-internal distribution replay，1000 warmup 后持续运行，PS 不参与逐样本决策
积分窗口: 用 delta_mWh/delta_time 计算窗口平均整板功率，delta_mAh/delta_time 只作平均电流交叉核对；同时计算整板总能耗/正确推理和 mode-matched 增量能耗/正确推理；至少 5 组交替 paired rounds

instrument.name: B10 high-precision Type-C multifunction USB voltage/current meter PD3.2
instrument.readout_method: manual reading with photo evidence and timestamp

measurement_point.location: meter in series between Type-C supply and development board
measurement_point.scope: whole-board input power; not pure NPU rail power

jtag_ps_state: JTAG used for communication only; identical JTAG/PS state across all four CP8 states
idle_definition: same bit/XSA/ELF, model loaded, identical JTAG/PS state, replay not started or stopped at frozen idle
forbidden_attribution: Vivado power estimate as board power
close_boundary: B3-POWER-MEASURED requires non-empty power_source, photo/manual-observation manifest path in external_trace, and finite positive external_power_w for all four states plus all six instrument fields; this does not by itself close B3-POWER-GATE. Until CP8 runs, status stays POWER_NOT_MEASURED / MEASUREMENT_OPEN.
discovery: B10 Type-C inline meter is available; COM15/COM35 are CH340 UART, COM32/FTDI 6014 are JTAG, not a wattmeter
